chapter: Society work, Camilla Todd and Storyville
title: Reel change; Crescent Band, Superior band and Peter Bocage
summary: Back on tape, Charles contrasts Ory and the Crescent band (no music) with the Superior band's violinist Peter Bocage.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Fiddlers and reading violinists of New Orleans

blocks.x: Okay, we've got it going now. This is a reel three, Hippolyte Charles, reel two, I'm sorry, Hippolyte Charles, August 13th, April 13th, 1963. The machine didn't work before and I got nervous. But it didn't work. You were saying about Ori and the Crescent Band.

I said the Crescent Band and Ori during those days, that was, you know, that was really getting work. Of course they had a lot of little bands that was playing but they didn't play no music at all. But Ori and the Crescent, Jack Kerrin there, was the only band that didn't use no music at all. You see? But you take the Superior, they had a very wonderful violin player and he was the leader, Peter Bocca. And that's where Bump got all the things that he did there.
Oh he did it? Bump Johnson got them from a fiddler?

The music? The music itself? Oh. Peter would make anybody play. Peter was considered one of our first class musicians. Oh yeah, Peter's a musician like you see him so. Oh yeah. And Peter could read anything you put there with that violin. I don't know what he could do with the trumpet. I knew he played the trumpet some. But his instrument was violin. You see we had Pierrot, we had John Robichon, we had Mac Neal, we had what's the name of that guy that used to lead the Pierrot. Jimmy Palard, those fellows were musicians. Big Guy used to play nice and parlour too. He used to read music pretty well too. But I'm talking about the real man that could play anything you'd put there. You'd put the Beethoven Symphony in D there, he could play that. Anything you could play. A trumpet song, flower song, Huguenot, any one of those. Take some of the best opera you could put there.
